content: Plan: Baseline established with Candidate 1 (best, reward=-0.9157) and Candidate 2 (-1.058). Candidate 1 has Itail~45uA, I2~105uA, Cc=1.5pF, Rc=800ohm, ln1=90nm giving Gain=707.6, Noise=0.0185V, Area=0.59um^2, Current=176.7uA. Reducing ln1 to 45nm in id=2 collapsed gain to 105. Violated in id=1: ugbw (-0.589, 25.9MHz), phm (-0.224, 38deg), slewRate (-0.133, 23V/us). Focus levers: boost gm1 and gm6 while managing Cc for phase margin and slew rate.

Candidate 1 is infeasible. Binding violations: ugbw (-0.589, 25.88MHz), phm (-0.224, 38.0deg), slewRate (-0.133, 23.0V/us). Gain (+0.559, 707.6) and noise have ample margin. Low PM is driven by second pole p2 = gm6/CL (CL=10pF) being too close to UGBW. Chosen lever: increase gm6 by scaling mp3/mn5 and tune Rc to cancel/move the zero to boost PM, enabling subsequent Cc reduction and gm1 scaling for UGBW/SR.

Round 1 result: Simulated ids 3, 4, 5. Lever (gm6 boost via mn5=8, mp3=16 and Rc increase to 2500) successfully cleared phase margin constraint: phm rose from 38.04 to 63.18 deg (feasible!). Reward improved from -0.9157 to -0.6532 (id 5). Current is 191.6uA (feasible). Only slewRate (23.21 V/us) and ugbw (29.01 MHz) remain violated. Returning to diagnoser.

Best is id 5 (reward -0.6532). Phm is now feasible (63.2 deg, +0.026 margin). Remaining violations: ugbw (-0.550, 29.01MHz) and slewRate (-0.128, 23.21V/us). Both are inversely proportional to Cc (SR ~ Itail/Cc, UGBW ~ gm1/(2*pi*Cc)). Chosen lever: reduce compensation capacitor cap from 1.5pF toward 1.0pF to clear slewRate (>30V/us) and increase mn1 to boost gm1 for UGBW, monitoring PM to keep it above 60 deg.

Round 2 result: Simulated ids 6, 7, 8. Reduced cap to 1.0pF, increased mn1 to 20 and res to 3500 ohm. Result (id 8): slewRate (30.98 V/us) and phm (61.11 deg) are now BOTH feasible! Gain=714, noise=0.0165V, current=192.4uA. Only single violated spec remains: ugbw (38.86 MHz vs 100 MHz target). Reward improved to -0.4133. Returning to diagnoser.

Best is id 8 (reward -0.4133). 4 of 5 hard constraints are feasible (gain, phm, slewRate, noise). Sole remaining violation is ugbw (-0.440, 38.86MHz vs 100MHz). Current (192uA) and area (0.63um^2) are well within targets (and are soft objectives). Chosen lever: reduce Cc to 0.6-0.7pF and max out input pair gm1 (mn1=24, wn1=2.75u), tuning Rc to hold PM >= 60 deg despite smaller Cc.

Round 3 result: Simulated ids 9, 10, 11. Scaling mn1=24, wn1=2.75u, Cc=0.6pF, mn5=12, mp3=24, res=5500 ohm achieved reward -0.1360 (id 11). Specs: UGBW reached 73.15MHz, phm=62.01 deg (feasible), slewRate=43.70 V/us (feasible), gain=718.9 (feasible), noise=0.0153V (feasible). Only UGBW remains slightly below target (73.15MHz vs 100MHz). Returning to diagnoser.

Best is id 11 (reward -0.1360). Only ugbw remains violated (73.15MHz vs 100MHz, -0.155). All other constraints are comfortably feasible. Chosen lever: boost I_tail from 45uA to 60uA (mn4=4) and set mp1=4 to maintain balance (mp3/mp1 = 24/4 = 6 = 2*12/4), and reduce cap to 0.4-0.5pF with res tuned to 6000-7000 ohm, to push UGBW past 100MHz for full feasibility.

Round 4 result: Simulated ids 12, 13, 14. With mn4=4, mp1=4, mn5=12, mp3=24, and cap=0.5pF/res=5500 (id 14), reward reached -0.05586. Specs: ugbw=91.96MHz (-0.0419), phm=56.20 deg (-0.0327), slewRate=55.14 V/us, gain=716.2, noise=0.0144V. Both remaining violations are within 4% of target. Lesson: Rc>6500 degraded PM due to higher-order pole; optimal Rc is ~5000-5500. Returning to diagnoser.

Best is id 14 (reward -0.05586). UGBW (91.96MHz) and phm (56.2 deg) are both within 4-7% of target. To push p2=gm6/CL higher and gain ~8-10 deg of PM without lowering Cc, chosen lever: widen stage 2 PMOS and mirror load together (wp3=1.5u, wp1=1.5u, keeping balance ratio 6), boosting gm6 by ~22% and setting res=4500.

Round 5 result: Simulated ids 15, 16, 17. Base id 16 achieved UGBW=107.0MHz (feasible!), slewRate=60.81 V/us (feasible), gain=713.9 (feasible), noise=0.0138V (feasible), reward=-0.02098. Only single violation is phm=55.56 deg. Lessons: widening mp3/wp1 in id 15 lowered PM due to Cgs parasitic loading; increasing res past 5500 in id 17 pushed UGBW to 114.6MHz but did not increase PM due to the non-dominant pole at the Miller resistor node. Returning to diagnoser.

Candidate 16 is at reward -0.02098, with 4 of 5 constraints feasible and phm at 55.56 deg (-0.0385). To supply the final ~4.5 deg of PM without losing UGBW (>105MHz), chosen lever: increase I_2 to 225uA (mn5=15) with mn4=5, mp1=4, mp3=24 (exact balance ratio 6.0). This boosts gm6 by 12% without increasing transistor gate capacitance, pushing p2 out and reducing mirror cap mp1 to achieve phm >= 60 deg.

Round 6 result: Simulated ids 18, 19, 20. id 18 (mn5=15, mp1=4, Itail=75u, I2=225u) reached ugbw=112.8MHz, slewRate=60.43V/us, phm=55.78 deg. id 20 with res=5600 reached ugbw=120.5MHz and phm=55.83 deg. PM remains stalled at ~56 deg despite various Rc values. Returning to diagnoser.

Stall detected: 3 sizer simulations in a row (ids 18, 19, 20) did not improve over best reward -0.02098 (id 16). Designs are clustered near feasibility with only phm (~55.6 deg vs 60 deg target) slightly binding while ugbw (107-120MHz), slewRate (60V/us), gain (>680), and noise (<0.015V) are all comfortably met. Handing over to rl strategist to explore the 20-D parameter space from these high-performing seeds.

RL phase completed: 548 simulations used (108 warmup + 440 training across 400 TD3 steps). Best design remained Candidate 16 (reward -0.02098). RL exploration did not uncover a superior parameter basin in 400 steps over the hand-crafted balance-constrained designs. Returning to diagnoser/sizer for targeted polish rounds.

Diagnoser polish decision: Candidate 20 has UGBW=120.5MHz (a 20% surplus over 100MHz) and phm=55.83 deg (-0.036). We previously saw Cc=0.6pF produced 62.01 deg PM in id 11. Chosen lever: trade the excess UGBW margin for phase margin by increasing cap from 0.5pF to 0.6pF with base_id 20 (Itail=75uA, I2=225uA, exact balance ratio 6), expecting UGBW ~100-102MHz and PM ~62-64 deg, achieving total feasibility.

Polish round result: Simulated ids 569, 570, 571. Full feasibility achieved! Best is Candidate 571 (reward 0.5619, feasible=True, violated=[]). Specs: gain=685.7 V/V, phm=63.26 deg, ugbw=110.2 MHz, slewRate=52.12 V/us, noise=0.0138 V, area=0.668 um^2, current=324.6 uA. All hard constraints met with comfortable safety margins. Returning to diagnoser.

Feasible solution secured with Candidate 571 (reward 0.5619, feasible=True, no violations). All 5 hard constraints satisfied: gain=685.7 V/V (+0.548), phm=63.26 deg (+0.026), ugbw=110.2 MHz (+0.049), slewRate=52.12 V/us (+0.269), noise=0.0138 V (-0.371). Handing over to reviewer to verify lineage and write full explanation report.

Run harness_20261105_181021 verified. Final optimal design is Candidate 571 (FoM/reward = 0.5619, feasible = True). Specs: Gain=685.7 V/V, PM=63.26 deg, UGBW=110.2 MHz, SR=52.12 V/us, Noise=0.0138 V RMS, Area=0.668 um^2, Current=324.6 uA. Detailed lineage, trade-off analysis, and lessons documented in harness_runs/harness_20261105_181021/explanation.md.
